items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the main highlight is the Bank of England rate decision. The BoE is widely expected to raise interest rates by 25 bps to 4.00%, marking the first hike in the current tightening cycle.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，主要亮点是英格兰银行的利率决定。人们普遍预计英国央行将加息25个基点至4.00% ，这是当前紧缩周期的首次加息。
